summary: AITX furnished an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting an Item 8.01 other-events press release announcing an order for seven RIO 360 solar-powered security systems through a RAD channel partner. The end user is a major public research university with over 25,000 students, indicating the initial seven units could precede additional orders for a broader campus deployment. No price, consideration, or premium was disclosed. This is a routine commercial product order announcement, not a special situation; terms and timing of any follow-on orders remain undisclosed.
